scripts.test:rules: firebase --config ../firebase.test.json emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-kotahouse "vitest run test/rules"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase --config ../firebase.test.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-kotahouse "vitest run test/integration"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
